queries_run: Mastercard stablecoin real-time payments threat to card networks 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 自述：即時帳戶對帳戶支付成熟後，國內 P2M/P2P 市佔競爭可能增加，跨境市佔也可能被基礎設施互連所擾動；多項產業倡議在試驗帳戶型全球機制，可能擾動清算結算選項。
findings.excerpt: As these real-time account-based propositions mature, we face a possible increase in competition for our existing domestic person-to-merchant (“P2M”) and person-to-person (“P2P”) transaction market share. Similarly, as interlinking of these infrastructures is further explored, they could disrupt our existing cross-border P2M and P2P market share.

findings.claim: 10-K 自述：穩定幣與加密貨幣可能隨監管（如 GENIUS Act）更普及，加密原生業者有能力擾動傳統金融市場；對公司既是機會也可能與其產品競爭。
findings.excerpt: Digital currencies and emerging players (such as crypto natives) have the ability to disrupt traditional financial markets. The increased prominence of digital currencies creates an opportunity for us, but could also compete with our products and services.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：新技術可能優於或使現有技術過時，並促使使用其技術的客戶（含金融科技與科技公司）改用自有技術與之競爭。
findings.excerpt: These changes could result in new technologies that may be superior to, or render obsolete, the technologies we currently use in our programs and services.

findings.claim: Mastercard 據報評估出售 Nets 即時支付單位，轉向穩定幣（BVNK）
findings.source: paymentexpert.com: Mastercard nets sale next rtp play
